methodology_summary: Identical methodology and code path to docs/v2/PHASE3_CANDIDATE_B_MEASUREMENT.md / docs/v2/PHASE3_HELDOUT_RESULTS.md, applied to the 12 NEW artifacts/v2/phase3_heldout_supplement.json cases instead of the spent phase3_heldout split. Real Cerebras qwen-3.8-27b Chat Completions calls (1 per case, no retry, tool_choice=auto, parallel_tool_calls=true), real HTTP calls to ClinicalTrials.gov for every registry_valid call. Run exactly once, blind, no tuning based on results.

clinical_trials_status_mapping_accuracy.note: Exact match to gold canonical status when explicit in query; RECRUITING (schema default) or omission accepted when no status was requested.

clinical_trials_phase_mapping_accuracy.note: Exact match to gold canonical phase when explicit/derivable; for SUP-CT-011 (deliberately ambiguous 'late-stage'), PHASE3/PHASE4/omitted all accepted per documented gold reasoning; omission accepted (not counted as error, but flagged) when the phase was requested but no explicit gold phase existed (e.g. NA/device cases where model chose to omit rather than emit NA).

phase_acceptable_but_inexact_detail.note: model omitted phase instead of emitting the canonical value; not a hallucination/wrong-value error, but not an exact match either

parameter_quality.semantically_invalid_parameter_rate: NOT MEASURED - requires a semantic judge, out of scope, same convention as prior Phase 3 measurements.

arbitrary_model_generated_callable_execu.note: execute_validated_call() only calls DEFAULT_REGISTRY.get_execution_fn(tool_name, operation); code-audited, unchanged from the frozen module used for the original heldout run.

arbitrary_model_generated_url_execution.note: All 3 tools use fixed hardcoded base URLs; the model never supplies a URL.

schema_invalid_call_reaching_executor.note: 0 schema-invalid call(s) occurred this run; none reached execute_validated_call (only registry_valid outcomes are executed by this harness).

unknown_tool_silent_fallback.note: Every rejected call recorded with a failure_category, never substituted or silently executed.

execution_reliability.note: Some individual ClinicalTrials.gov HTTP attempts logged a transient error during the run (visible in stdout) but were automatically recovered by utils/retry_handler.py's RetrySession before this harness recorded the execution outcome -- every recorded execution_record in this run is status=success, consistent with the retry-recovery convention documented in docs/v2/PHASE3_HELDOUT_RESULTS.md Section 2.

multi_source.note: This supplement is deliberately clinicaltrials_only in category (per the task's scope: ClinicalTrials phase/status filtering specifically) -- 0 multi-source gold cases, so this metric is N/A here by design, not a gap.

model_calls_per_case.note: Exactly 1 Cerebras call per case, no retry.

pricing_used.source: Frozen Phase-2 Cerebras qwen-3.8-27b pricing, reused verbatim.

cost.spend_cap_note: Trivially small against any Phase-3 spend cap; well under the original heldout run's $0.0233 for 15 cases on a per-case basis.

Show phase 3 trials of a bispecific antibody for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that are ongoing but no longer taking new participants.
What phase 4 trials of an ACE inhibitor for chronic kidney disease have already finished?
Are there any early phase 1 trials of a gene therapy for sickle cell disease that have been put on hold?
Find trials of a continuous glucose monitoring device for type 1 diabetes that were stopped early and never completed.
What phase 2 trials of a new antibiotic for drug-resistant tuberculosis were withdrawn before starting?
Are there any trials currently recruiting patients for a CAR-NK cell therapy in acute myeloid leukemia?
What clinical trials exist for a GLP-2 analog in short bowel syndrome?
Is anyone studying fecal microbiota transplantation for recurrent Clostridioides difficile infection in a clinical trial?
Are there any late-stage trials of an oral factor XI inhibitor for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation?

gold.gold_ambiguous_phase_note: 'late-stage' is colloquial trial-industry shorthand commonly used for Phase 3 and/or Phase 4 trials, but it has NO single unambiguous mapping onto exactly one VALID_TRIAL_PHASES member -- unlike 'phase 3' or 'completed', it names no canonical value directly, and reasonable readers disagree whether it includes Phase 4. Gold-label judgment call (documented, not concealed): the CORRECT model behavior on this specific parameter is either (a) omit phase entirely (safest, avoids guessing), or (b) supply PHASE3 or PHASE4 specifically -- both scored as acceptable/non-hallucinating outcomes for the phase field on this case; any OTHER phase value (e.g. PHASE1, EARLY_PHASE1, NA) or any non-enum string is scored as a mapping failure. This deliberately differs from the malformed-parameter cases (FL-001/FL-002 in the main benchmark), which test a value with NO valid mapping at all -- here a *range* of plausible values exists, and the interesting question is whether the model abstains or narrows to a defensible choice rather than inventing a non-canonical string like 'late-stage' or 'Phase 3/4'.
